Many thanks to everyone who replied to my letter in an earlier OUTLET. Illness and, of course, the postal strike, prevented me writing earlier but I will do so in due course.  
— Andrew Clapham.

---

**WANTED:** Information/advice on using the Spectrum to control a MODEL RAILWAY.  
Contact: CHRIS CLAYTON, 21 RUDCHESTER CLOSE, CARLISLE, CA2 7XL (Carlisle 32150)

**ZX-COMAL** inclusive English manual. Structure your programs with PROC, LOOP, CASE, etc. Single key entry, 32K programmable RAM free. Normally only tape operations but info included with tips on how to use disc or microdrive. Only 135 dkr (about `12) including postage. Please use GIRO 8 56 41 91.  
Address: Leif Mortensen, Bryggervangen 29, DK-7120 Vejle 0st, Denmark.  
DELIVERY: 14 DAYS

**ALPHACOM PRINTER.** Good condition with power supply. One and a bit rolls of thermal paper. `15 or W.H.Y...  
Anyone else using a (Sinclair) Spectrum 128/D'ktronic printer interface/Seikosha GP100a printer combination? The screen-dump from this set-up is terrible. Please let me know if you've solved the problem.  
JOHN LUBY, 38 Winterfield Gardens, DUNS, Berwickshire.

Send to Lars Jespersen, Monsgade 16a, DK-8000 Arhus C, Denmark (Tel: 06-183661) for details.

— Alan Rutherford, 33 Montgomery Road, Cove, Farnborough, Hants, GU14 0AY

57 St.Saviours Road, WEST CROYDON, Surrey, CR0 2XE

— Brian Gaff.
